== ''Usage'' ==

'''Fighting'''

The Living Cleaver is a Melee Weapon. Its attack reach is 4 blocks in every direction from the players head, which is the default attack reach.

Each time it is swung, it performs a sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne or the attack cooldown is still up) and applies the [[Viral]] Effect to the directly targeted mob.

'''Evolving'''

Upon killing an entity, it's hp, including possible buffs from health boost, are added to a counter shown in the item's tooltip. 1 second after this counter reaches 50,000, a non-damaging lightning will strike the player, and the held weapon will be replaced with it's Sentient counterpart at full durability.
